newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa called to open down $25 on weak LIFFE.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa called to open down $25 on weak LIFFE.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open $25 lower Thursday on the heels of a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.

LIFFE cocoa futures sank to fresh four-month lows early on speculative long liquidation. At the midday break, benchmark September was down 20 stg at 966 stg a tonne, just shy of the day's low of 965 stg. December dropped 14 stg to 1,003 stg.

Wednesday, New York cocoa futures erased gains and drifted to a weaker close. September cocoa settled $5 lower at $1,497 a tonne after ranging from $1,520 to $1,496. Second-month December eased $2 to $1,547, while the back months finished unchanged to off $1.
Technically, traders pegged September support at $1,475, with the next downside target seen at $1,450 to $1,448. They continued to see the $1,521 to $1,526 gap as its upside chart objective.
